observed: Two of four previously accepted real fault arms contain one bash sampler race diagnostic on wrapper.stderr: /proc/<controller>/fd/<fd>: line 436: /proc/<reaped>/stat: No such file or directory.
diagnosis: The diagnostic is emitted when the expected-failure process exits between the sampler's PID discovery and stat read. It is not a candidate, kernel, CUDA, memory, cgroup or cleanup failure. A blanket empty-stderr rule rejects genuine preserved evidence.
bounded_fix: Permit zero or one exact process-stat disappearance diagnostic; reject every other stderr byte. Preserve all existing kernel, fatal-count, stdout, sample and digest checks.
acceptance_test: Both empty stderr and the exact sampler-race line pass; arbitrary stderr still fails; all four real candidate-13 fault directories pass the complete artifact validator.
